definition: Apache Spark is a distributed computation engine for large-scale data processing and analytics.
entry_text: Apache Spark is a distributed computation engine for large-scale data processing and analytics.
example: A team aggregates months of event records across a cluster.
label: Apache Spark

sources.note: Spark lists batch and streaming processing, distributed SQL analytics, large-scale exploratory analysis, and cluster execution for machine-learning workloads. These substantiate the generic engine description without a performance guarantee.
